verdict.rationale: Asking an analytics database about natural-language, semantically grounded answers is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an MCP server that lets coding agents list services and run raw SQL. It also shows table- and column-level role scoping and full query logging. None of these is a semantic layer or a business-user natural-language Q&A capability that prevents hallucinated joins. Those are adjacent building blocks, not this story's capability.
